items.name: Veihaukeskjegg
botanicalRequirements: Yellow, all-ligulate flower heads, several to numerous on an upright branching plant
Basal lanceolate or lobed leaves and much smaller narrow clasping upper stem leaves
Two rows of involucral bracts, with short outer awl-shaped bracts and hairy longer inner bracts
Narrow flower stems, buds and a realistic taproot or basal stem; recognizably distinct from Crepis capillaris
items.observations: Species morphology has been checked against botanical descriptions, but an original image is not yet produced and no visual approval has been issued.
items.limitations: No WebP artifact exists in this branch; no image, Git blob, dimensions, SHA256, visual review or browser QA is claimed.
publicationBlockedBy: Create and botanically review an original 1024x1536 transparent WebP with no photographic appearance.
Upload its exact binary Git blob to the PR branch and update hashes, size, quality record, registry and browser/release tests.
Pass illustration-contract and approved-flora-browser on final head; verify GitHub Pages after merge.
